defaults_case.why: optional timing_factor defaults to 1.0 and other_revenue to 0.0; the default is NOT an authorisation to fill 1/0 when the disclosure is missing

zero_units_with_other.why: zero confirmed volume must not be treated as 'missing'; other_revenue still applies

mapping_1_same_table.timing_factor: 1 (already full-year exposed volume; must not be scaled again)
mapping_1_same_table.other_revenue: 0 (not disclosed in that table; not assumed)
mapping_1_same_table.constructive_note: unit_revenue is derived by dividing the SAME disclosed revenue cell by the SAME disclosed volume cell, so the zero residual is an identity, not evidence. It proves dimensional wiring only.

mapping_2_scope_residual.why: The automobile segment revenue line also contains secondary rechargeable batteries, vehicle parts and other products, which unit_sales cannot identify. The gap must NOT be silently treated as residual revenue.

mapping_3_mix.note: single unit price hides the sedan/SUV/MPV mix (p23 lines: 2,370,709 / 1,805,441 / 104,934)

disclosure_arithmetic.not_a_forecast: FY2024 is a closed, already-disclosed period; this is a historical mapping probe only
